name: Risk Department
description: The department responsible for the ownership and management of the Risk Assessment Template & Guidance.

name: Compliance Department
description: The department co-responsible for the Risk Assessment Template & Guidance.

name: Operational Risk
description: A risk category encompassing failures in internal processes, such as data entry errors during application forms and physical mail loss during statement delivery.
context: Application Form | Data Entry Error | Incorrect customer name captured | Operational
Statement Delivery | Mail Loss | Physical statement lost in post | Operational

name: Compliance Risk
description: A risk category covering regulatory and legal failures, specifically including fraud via forged documents during KYC and false positives during AML screening.
context: KYC Verification | Fraud | Forged document submitted | Compliance
AML Screening | False Positive | Legitimate customer matches sanctions list | Compliance

name: Technology Risk
description: A risk category relating to system availability and failures, such as the AMS system being unavailable during account creation.
context: Account Creation | System Failure | AMS unavailable, account not created | Technology

name: Customer Service Department
description: One of the two staff departments involved in the online account opening process.
context: Process involves 4 systems (IBP, AMS, FDE, DW) and 2 staff departments (Customer Service, Compliance).

name: Compliance Department
description: One of the two staff departments involved in the online account opening process, responsible for oversight and verification.
context: Process involves 4 systems (IBP, AMS, FDE, DW) and 2 staff departments (Customer Service, Compliance).

name: Online Account Opening Product
aliases: Account opening process via online channel
description: The banking product/process where customers apply online, provide KYC, undergo AML screening, and receive an account within 2 business days.
context: Account opening process via online channel. Customers complete application, provide KYC documents, undergo AML screening, and receive account within 2 business days.

name: KYC Verification Process
description: The verification step in the account opening process, identified as a point of risk for fraud via forged documents.
context: KYC Verification | Fraud | Forged document submitted | Compliance

name: AML Screening Process
description: The screening step in the account opening process, identified as a point of risk for false positives against sanctions lists.
context: AML Screening | False Positive | Legitimate customer matches sanctions list | Compliance

name: Credit Risk
description: A risk category concerning loan defaults and credit losses, with a defined risk appetite tolerance of a loss ratio of less than 0.5%.

name: Operational Risk
description: A risk category covering process failures, errors, and fraud, with a risk appetite tolerance of less than £50k per year.

name: Compliance Risk
description: A risk category involving regulatory violations and policy breaches, with a zero-tolerance risk appetite (0 violations).

name: Technology Risk
description: A risk category encompassing system failures and cyber attacks, with a risk appetite target of 99.9% uptime.

name: Fraud Risk
description: A risk category covering theft, money laundering, and impersonation, with a risk appetite tolerance of less than £100k per year.

name: Reputational Risk
description: A risk category related to brand damage and customer loss.

name: Liquidity Risk
description: A risk category concerning cash flow constraints.

name: Market Risk
description: A risk category involving interest rate and currency fluctuations.

name: Credit Risk Loss Ratio — Threshold <0.5%
description: The risk appetite threshold for Credit Risk, specified as a loss ratio of less than 0.5%.

name: Operational Risk Annual Loss — Threshold <£50k/year
description: The risk appetite threshold for Operational Risk, limited to less than £50,000 per year.

name: Compliance Violation Count — Threshold 0
description: The risk appetite threshold for Compliance Risk, requiring zero violations.

name: Fraud Risk Annual Loss — Threshold <£100k/year
description: The risk appetite threshold for Fraud Risk, limited to less than £100,000 per year.

name: Technology Uptime — Threshold 99.9%
description: The risk appetite threshold for Technology Risk, requiring 99.9% system uptime.

name: Customer Data Entry Error — Operational Risk
description: Risk where customers provide incorrect personal information during online account opening, which is accepted by the system and later found to be discrepant during regulatory verification. It is currently scored as a Medium Risk with a risk score of 9.
context: Customer completes online account opening form with incorrect personal information (wrong name spelling, incorrect DOB, incorrect address).
System accepts entry and creates account with bad data. Later regulatory verification finds discrepancies.

name: Operational Risk Target — Target <£50k/year, Current ~£20k/year
description: The quantitative appetite threshold for operational risk associated with data entry errors, currently operating within tolerance.

name: Implement client-side form validation (real-time)
description: Technical implementation of real-time validation on the online form to catch 90% of errors before submission, assigned to the Technology department with a deadline of 2026-02-28.
context: Implement client-side form validation (real-time) | Technology | 2026-02-28 | Catch 90% of errors pre-submission

name: Require confirmation of key fields (name, DOB)
description: Requirement for customers to confirm key identity fields to reduce entry errors by 50%, assigned to the Technology department with a deadline of 2026-02-28.
context: Require confirmation of key fields (name, DOB) | Technology | 2026-02-28 | Reduce entry errors by 50%

name: Automated post-opening verification call (IVR)
description: Implementation of an automated IVR call for post-opening verification to catch 100% of remaining errors, assigned to Customer Service with a deadline of 2026-03-31.
context: Automated post-opening verification call (IVR) | Customer Service | 2026-03-31 | Catch 100% of remaining errors

name: Retail Banking
description: The business unit responsible for the Online Account Opening process.

name: Technology
description: Department responsible for form validation controls and the implementation of real-time validation and field confirmation actions.
context: Online form validation (name field required, format check) | Technology

name: Customer Service
description: Department responsible for manual application review, post-opening verification, and the implementation of the IVR verification call.
context: Manual review of application before account creation | CSR
Automated post-opening verification call (IVR) | Customer Service

name: Online Account Opening
description: The digital process and product offering for opening new bank accounts, currently under risk assessment for data quality.

name: Risk Assessment Governance Framework
description: The governance framework defining the mandatory and recommended triggers for performing risk assessments within the bank. It ensures risk evaluations are conducted during new implementations, product launches, system changes, and regulatory updates.

name: Mandatory Risk Assessment for New Process Implementation
description: A mandatory requirement to perform a risk assessment whenever a new process is implemented.

name: Mandatory Risk Assessment for New Product Launch
description: A mandatory requirement to perform a risk assessment upon the launch of a new product.

name: Mandatory Risk Assessment for Major System Change
description: A mandatory requirement to perform a risk assessment following a major system change.

name: Mandatory Risk Assessment for Regulatory Requirement Change
description: A mandatory requirement to perform a risk assessment when there is a change in regulatory requirements.

name: Annual Risk Assessment for Critical Processes
description: A mandatory annual requirement to conduct risk assessments for all processes designated as critical.

name: Recommended Risk Assessment After Significant Incident
description: A recommended action to perform a risk assessment following the occurrence of a significant incident.

name: Recommended Risk Assessment Upon Process Metric Degradation
description: A recommended action to perform a risk assessment when process metrics show degradation.

name: Recommended Risk Assessment Upon Management Request
description: A recommended action to perform a risk assessment when specifically requested by management.

name: Recommended Risk Assessment After External Audit Finding
description: A recommended action to perform a risk assessment following the identification of a finding by an external audit.

name: Risk Score Threshold — Low (1–5)
description: Quantitative risk score range defined as Low, requiring approval from the Department Head within a 10-day timeline.

name: Risk Score Threshold — Medium (6–12)
description: Quantitative risk score range defined as Medium, requiring approval from the Head of Risk within a 5-day timeline.

name: Risk Score Threshold — High (13–18)
description: Quantitative risk score range defined as High, requiring approval from the Risk Committee and Executive within a 2-day timeline.

name: Risk Score Threshold — Critical (19–25)
description: Quantitative risk score range defined as Critical, requiring approval from the Board and CEO within a 24-hour timeline.

name: Department Head
description: The organizational role responsible for approving risks scored between 1 and 5.

name: Head of Risk
description: The organizational role responsible for approving risks scored between 6 and 12.

name: Risk Committee
description: The governance body responsible for approving high-level risks scored between 13 and 18.

name: Board
description: The highest governance body responsible for approving critical risks scored between 19 and 25.

name: Risk Reporting Distribution Frequency — Low Level: Quarterly
description: The defined reporting frequency for Low risk level events, which are distributed to the Department Head and Risk Team on a quarterly basis.
context: Low | Department Head, Risk Team | Quarterly

name: Risk Reporting Distribution Frequency — Medium Level: Monthly
description: The defined reporting frequency for Medium risk level events, which are distributed to the Exec Committee on a monthly basis.

name: Risk Reporting Distribution Frequency — High Level: Weekly
description: The defined reporting frequency for High risk level events, which are distributed to the Risk Committee on a weekly basis.

name: Risk Reporting Distribution Frequency — Critical Level: Immediate
description: The defined reporting frequency for Critical risk level events, which are distributed to the Board immediately.

name: Risk Team
description: The internal department responsible for receiving quarterly reports on Low risk level events.
context: Low | Department Head, Risk Team | Quarterly

name: Exec Committee
description: The executive governance body responsible for receiving monthly reports on Medium risk level events.

name: Risk Committee
description: The governance committee responsible for receiving weekly reports on High risk level events.

name: Board
description: The highest governing body of the bank, responsible for receiving immediate reports on Critical risk level events.

name: Likelihood Scale - Remote (1)
description: A risk likelihood metric defined as 'Remote', indicating an event is unlikely in the foreseeable future with a frequency of less than one event per 10 years.

name: Likelihood Scale - Low (2)
description: A risk likelihood metric defined as 'Low', indicating an event may occur in 3+ years with a frequency of 1 event per 3–10 years.

name: Likelihood Scale - Medium (3)
description: A risk likelihood metric defined as 'Medium', indicating an event may occur in 1–3 years with a frequency of 1 event per 1–3 years.

name: Likelihood Scale - High (4)
description: A risk likelihood metric defined as 'High', indicating an event is likely in less than 1 year with a frequency of 4 or more events per year.

name: Likelihood Scale - Very High (5)
description: A risk likelihood metric defined as 'Very High', indicating an event could occur multiple times per year with a frequency of weekly or more.
context: 5 = Very High (Could occur multiple times per year)

name: Impact Scale Level 1 — Negligible
description: The lowest tier of the impact scale, defined as Negligible. It applies when financial impact is less than £10k, affecting 1–5 customers, with no regulatory impact.

name: Impact Scale Level 2 — Minor
description: The second tier of the impact scale, defined as Minor. It applies when financial impact is between £10k and £100k, affecting 5–25 customers, with no formal regulatory action.

name: Impact Scale Level 3 — Moderate
description: The middle tier of the impact scale, defined as Moderate. It applies when financial impact is between £100k and £500k, affecting 25–100 customers, resulting in regulatory review or minor guidance.

name: Impact Scale Level 4 — Major
description: The fourth tier of the impact scale, defined as Major. It applies when financial impact is between £500k and £1M, affecting 100–500 customers, and resulting in regulatory fines or restrictions.

name: Impact Scale Level 5 — Critical
description: The highest tier of the impact scale, defined as Critical. It applies when financial impact exceeds £1M, affecting over 500 customers, and resulting in license suspension or criminal action.

name: Risk Assessment Documentation Filing Requirement
description: A requirement to maintain a comprehensive file for each risk assessment, including signed forms, evidence, control evaluations, mitigation plans, approval signatures, and implementation tracking.
context: For each risk assessment, keep on file:

name: Risk Data Retention Policy
description: The bank maintains a risk data retention requirement of 7 years to support audit trails and regulatory inquiries. Data is stored in an encrypted secure risk repository with access restricted to the Risk team and process owners.
context: Keep: 7 years (supports audit trail, regulatory inquiries)
Access: Risk team + process owner only

name: Data Retention Period — 7 Years
description: The quantitative requirement for the duration that risk-related data must be kept to ensure regulatory compliance and auditability.
context: Keep: 7 years (supports audit trail, regulatory inquiries)

name: Risk Team
description: The department granted authorized access to the encrypted secure risk repository.
context: Access: Risk team + process owner only

name: Residual Risk Calculation
description: The requirement to calculate risk after considering existing controls rather than scoring risk in isolation.

name: Mitigation Action Assignment Standard
description: A governance requirement that every mitigation action must be assigned a specific owner, a target date, and a defined expected impact.
context: Each action must have owner, target date, expected impact

name: Quarterly Control Retesting and Risk Recalculation
description: A mandatory recurring task to retest controls and recalculate residual risk on a quarterly basis following mitigation.
context: Retest controls and recalculate residual risk quarterly

name: Risk Assessment Centralisation Policy
description: A governance requirement that risk assessments must not be kept solely by department owners but must be filed with the Risk team for a consolidated view.
context: File with Risk team for consolidated view

name: Risk Team
description: The central department responsible for maintaining the consolidated view of risk assessments across the bank.
context: File with Risk team for consolidated view
